chain.title: Tapper's First Draw
chain.desc: Crafted from three planks and a stick, then right-clicked on a rubber tree's sap hole to collect sap.

chain.title: The Bleeding Tree
chain.desc: Smelted in any furnace from the sap a treetap draws out of rubber trees.

chain.title: Iron, Only Better
chain.desc: Smelted or blasted from a plain vanilla iron ingot, and later mass-produced in the industrial blast furnace.

chain.title: Skeleton of Industry
chain.desc: Eight refined iron ingots ringed around an empty centre slot in the crafting grid.

chain.title: Etched in Silicon
chain.desc: Assembled in the assembling machine from one silicon plate and two copper plates.

chain.title: Smelting Without Smoke
chain.desc: An iron furnace flanked by redstone with an electronic circuit set above it.

chain.title: Twice From Every Vein
chain.desc: Flint over cobblestone, a basic machine frame and an electronic circuit; it mills ores into dust.

chain.title: Squeezed Flat
chain.desc: Stone walls around a basic machine frame with an electronic circuit, pressing ingots and dusts into plates.

chain.title: Latex Line
chain.desc: Four treetaps and an electronic circuit built onto a basic machine frame.

chain.title: First Spark on the Grid
chain.desc: A shapeless mix of a red cell battery, a basic machine frame and a furnace; it burns fuel into energy.

chain.title: Electrum Logic
chain.desc: Assembled from one silicon plate and two electrum plates in the assembling machine.

chain.title: Carbon Reinforced
chain.desc: A basic machine frame flanked by advanced alloy plates with carbon plates above and below.

chain.title: White Heat
chain.desc: An electric furnace and advanced circuits bolted to an advanced machine frame with cupronickel heating coils.

chain.title: Carburised
chain.desc: Fired in the industrial blast furnace from a refined iron ingot and four coal dust.

chain.title: Ore Rendered Down
chain.desc: A grinder, an industrial electrolyzer, diamond grinding heads and advanced circuits on an advanced machine frame.

chain.title: The Blue Battery
chain.desc: Lazurite plates and industrial circuits packed around an energy crystal.

chain.title: Titanium Chassis
chain.desc: Chromium and titanium plates pressed around an advanced machine frame.

chain.title: Absolute Cold
chain.desc: An extractor, steel plates, advanced circuits and reinforced glass; it quenches white-hot ingots.

chain.title: Quenched Tungstensteel
chain.desc: Chilled in the vacuum freezer from a hot tungstensteel ingot.

chain.title: Orb of Stored Lightning
chain.desc: Eight lapotron crystals wrapped around a single iridium alloy plate.

chain.title: Flow Control
chain.desc: Assembled from a lapotron crystal and an industrial circuit.

chain.title: Matter From Scrap
chain.desc: Industrial machine frames, extractors and energy flow chips built around a lapotronic orb.

chain.title: Winding the Coil
chain.desc: An advanced machine casing wound with superconductors, nichrome heating coils, energy flow chips and an iridium neutron reflector.

chain.title: Star in a Bottle
chain.desc: Energy crystals and energy flow chips assembled around a fusion coil to run the fusion reactor.

notes: Verified against the Fabric build of Tech Reborn 5.8.15 for 1.20.1 (the only 1.20.1 build published on Modrinth; item ids are identical on any loader). Ids were checked as the intersection of assets/techreborn/models/item/*.json stems with item./block. keys in assets/*/lang/en_us.json, widened by ids referenced inside data/techreborn/**. Progression was read directly from data/techreborn/recipes/**: crafting_table/machine/*, assembling_machine/*, blast_furnace/*, vacuum_freezer/* and fusion_reactor/*. Fusion reactor recipes in the jar output helium3, helium plasma, iridium ore and platinum dust from deuterium/tritium/wolframium cells, so the chain ends at the fusion_control_computer rather than a fluid. Nothing was dropped: every id listed passed the set-membership check.
